name: Meal Planning Rules & Conflict Resolution
purpose: Score, filter, and explain meal/food recommendations using hard requirements, soft goals, genetic context, lab context, and user preferences.

conflict_examples.case: fish encouraged but fish allergy present
conflict_examples.resolution: Disable fish suggestions; use algal DHA/EPA and non-fish protein sources.
Use beef/lamb if allowed, shellfish if allowed, fish, poultry, legumes/tofu with vitamin C, or clinician-guided iron supplement.
Use fortified foods or B12 supplement; do not recommend animal foods.
Use tolerated low-FODMAP fiber sources and structured reintroduction.
Use very fresh/frozen low-mercury fish; avoid canned, smoked, fermented, or leftover fish.
Do not recommend high-protein targets; require renal labs/clinician guidance.

conflict_examples.case: MTHFR variant but folic acid fear
conflict_examples.resolution: Do not advise folic-acid avoidance solely from genotype; check folate/B12/homocysteine and follow pregnancy/medical guidance.

conflict_examples.case: ApoB/Lp(a) risk but ketogenic high saturated-fat preference
conflict_examples.resolution: Require lipid feedback; prioritize unsaturated-fat/fiber pattern if ApoB rises.

do_not_do: Do not recommend foods that violate a user-declared religious/cultural restriction.
Do not infer food restrictions from ethnicity/religion; ask or let user set profile.
Do not diagnose allergy, celiac, PMDD, diabetes, CKD, or eating disorders from genotype.
Do not use raw DNA as the sole basis for strict long-term elimination diets.
Do not treat absence of an rsID as absence of risk.
Do not suggest high-dose supplements or medication changes without clinician context.
